about: The modelling ratchet (#1866, epic #1007). Each count may only fall. A rise needs an appended entry with an "exemption" naming an issue. Append, never rewrite. See ratchet.ts.

writer-census.untransferable.what: Core-served asks no derived writer can take over: patterns only the syntactic core (notation/parse.ts) can open or edit correctly, both surfaces.

history.note: Baseline when the ratchet was added, on origin/main 612772aa over mini-corpus.json. It grew 68 → 70 (#1827), 70 → 76 (#1849), 76 → 77 (#1849's <…> half) before the ratchet existed, each re-pinned in the change that moved it — see #1867.

writer-census.unverified.what: Core-served asks with no probe to verify them (outcome `no-probe`): the syntactic core serves them, and nothing has shown a derived writer can — or cannot — take them over.

history.note: Baseline, on origin/main 612772aa over mini-corpus.json. It grew 109 → 121 (#1849) and 121 → 122 (#1849's <…> half) before it was watched. Watched beside untransferable so an ask cannot leave that count by losing its probe (#1872).

writer-census.p6-blocker.what: The set that blocks deleting the syntactic core (P6, #1012): structural untransferable asks whose core view has structure and whose core edit is verified, both surfaces, at the shipped caps LEAF_PROJECT_BARS = { grid: 12, roll: 4 } (exported as PROJECTION_PERIOD_BOUNDS.leaf; the census reads the roll cap from there).

history.note: Baseline when the ratchet was added (grid 20 + roll 35), on origin/main 612772aa. It grew 51 → 53 (#1827), 53 → 54 (#1849), 54 → 55 (#1849's <…> half) before the ratchet existed — see #1867. A change to either cap moves this count and must be recorded here like any other move.

predicate-audit.anchored.what: Anchored regular expressions in ir/parseStrudel.ts that decide what Strudel syntax means (M1, P5 #1011).

history.note: Baseline when the ratchet was added, on origin/main 612772aa. #1007's body says 36; PREDICATE-AUDIT.md records the move to 37.
